metric_scope.boundary_assd_normalized: symmetric boundary distance inside the same ROI, divided by the scan median mesh-edge length
metric_scope.local_semantic_accuracy: accuracy inside a GT-tooth mask dilated by 8 mesh rings
metric_scope.regional_biou: zero-tolerance one-ring boundary IoU restricted to the same GT-defined ROI
metric_scope.tooth_iou: full-scan FDI-label IoU for the GT tooth label

selection_disclosure: All rankings are post-hoc diagnostics over frozen predictions. They identify display regions and failure modes; they do not replace scan-level aggregate evaluation.
